Use annual year-end snapshots, from the earliest dept_emp.from_date year through the latest actual historical date in dept_emp (maximum from_date or non-sentinel to_date less than '9999-01-01'), and use that latest historical date as the snapshot for the final partial year.
```sql
WITH date_range AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT YEAR(from_date) AS year
    FROM dept_emp
    WHERE to_date < '9999-01-01'
), snapshot_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE(CONCAT(year, '-12-31')) AS snapshot_date
    FROM date_range
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        MAX(to_date) 
    FROM dept_emp 
    WHERE to_date < '9999-01-01'
), employee_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.snapshot_date,
        d.dept_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT de.emp_no) AS employee_count
    FROM snapshot_dates sd
    CROSS JOIN departments d
    LEFT JOIN dept_emp de ON 
        de.from_date <= sd.snapshot_date AND 
        de.to_date > sd.snapshot_date AND 
        de.dept_no = d.dept_no
    GROUP BY sd.snapshot_date, d.dept_name
)
SELECT 
    snapshot_date, 
    dept_name, 
    employee_count 
FROM employee_counts
ORDER BY snapshot_date, dept_name;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE years AS (
    SELECT YEAR(MIN(from_date)) AS year
    FROM dept_emp
    UNION ALL
    SELECT year + 1
    FROM years
    WHERE year < YEAR(GREATEST((SELECT MAX(from_date) FROM dept_emp), (SELECT MAX(to_date) FROM dept_emp WHERE to_date != '9999-12-31')))
),
events AS (
    SELECT 
        dept_no,
        YEAR(event_date) AS year,
        SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'in' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS delta
    FROM (
        SELECT dept_no, from_date AS event_date, 'in' AS event_type
        FROM dept_emp
        UNION ALL
        SELECT dept_no, to_date AS event_date, 'out' AS event_type
        FROM dept_emp
        WHERE to_date != '9999-12-31'
    ) AS derived_events
    GROUP BY dept_no, year
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        d.dept_no,
        d.dept_name,
        y.year,
        COALESCE(SUM(e.delta) OVER (PARTITION BY d.dept_no ORDER BY y.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) AS employee_count
    FROM departments d
    CROSS JOIN years y
    LEFT JOIN events e ON d.dept_no = e.dept_no AND e.year = y.year
)
SELECT 
    LEAST(CONCAT(y.year, '-12-31'), CURDATE()) AS snapshot_date,
    d.dept_name,
    COALESCE(c.employee_count, 0) AS employee_count
FROM departments d
LEFT JOIN cumulative c ON d.dept_no = c.dept_no
ORDER BY d.dept_no, snapshot_date;
```
